reader_summary.headline: Kristin Kallergis Rowland is the Global Head of Alternative Investments for J.P.
reader_summary.overview: Kristin Kallergis Rowland is the Global Head of Alternative Investments for J.P. Morgan Wealth Management, where she oversees $180 billion of alternative investments within the $500 billion managed in J.P. The Private Bank's investment approach resembles that of many institutions, with centralized research, manager selection, and portfolio construction that its financial advisors use in client portfolios.

key_points.text: KK has spent her entire career in private wealth at J.P.
Morgan, spanning investment functions and global geographies.
Morgan's centralized approach to alternative investing for its clients.
